scene resetwithmaya1
: ...Maya?
: But...
: What?...
The seven second intervals separating Maya’s dream-induced twitches disappear along with the reluctant acceptance that I will never see her again.
I think I must have inherited them, as my body interprets this miraculous turn of events as an attack on itself- or at least the remnants of gods still circulating throughout my bloodstream.
A flood of unfamiliar feelings fills my heart and subsequently the rest of me, draining every last lingering ounce of divinity out of my veins and into a lurking container housing only half of a man.
Perhaps this will be the wake-up call I need.
Or perhaps I’ll take it as proof that there never was a god. For if there was or if there is, this is certainly not an act on their behalf.
It simply doesn’t match their preferred form of comedy.
scene resetwithmaya2
Two pairs of empty eyes meet in the darkest corner of a bedroom and exchange absolutely nothing.
They latch onto each other because the idea of looking anywhere else reminds them that straying too far from home can be dangerous.
But in that moment, the hosts of each pair of eyes are reminded that there has never been anywhere that has felt like home at all.
And that all they have ever done is stray.
scene resetwithmaya3
I thank my organs for their constant twisting as they managed to lure me here before anywhere else.
I thank Ayane for convincing me to look in the first place.
I thank myself and the circumstances and everything I can think of except whatever forces brought us to this dark corner.
All that remains at this point is to find a home.
To find a place to come back to so neither one of us ever has to stray again.
But before that-
A celebration is in order.

scene resetwithmaya4
: AAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: Why couldn’t I see her?...
: AHHHH! AAAAAAHHH!!!! AAHHHH...HAAHHH...AHAHHHHHH!!
This is not the first time I’ve had the misfortune of feeling the tears of a young girl seep through the fabric of my shirt.
It is, however, the first time I have not felt an immediate compulsion to get changed.
These are the most welcome tears I have ever felt.
So why can’t I bring myself to embrace her back?
Is it because of the shock?
Because just moments ago I was unsure of whether or not I’d ever get to experience something like this?
Is it because of fear?
Because I have subconsciously began to heed her warnings and keep my distance?
Or is it because I now understand the gravity of exactly what that means?
And that the world itself is not what will come to an end-
But that it would be one of us that does.
And that is somehow even worse.
: IT FELT SO REAL!
: IT FELT LIKE I WAS BACK THERE!
: AND YOU WERE THERE, BUT...BUT IT WASN’T YOU! IT WAS A FAKE YOU!
: AND THAT FUCKING CUNT NORIKO WAS THERE TOO! AND...AND MY DESK!
: AND THE CLOCK! AND THE POSTERS! AND THE COMPUTER AND THE NOTEBOOKS AND THAT BLANKET YOU BOUGHT FROM THE THRIFT STORE!
: IT WAS ALL THERE, SENSEI!
: IT WAS ALL RIGHT THERE! BUT IT WASN’T!
: IT FELT SO REAL! IT FELT SO REAL!! IT FELT SO REAL!!!
: IT TOOK EVERYTHING I HAD TO FIGHT IT, YOU KNOW?! I’M REALLY FUCKING AMAZING, YOU KNOW?!
: I’M DOING ALL OF THIS FOR YOU, YOU KNOW?!
: I DON’T WANT TO LEAVE! I WANT TO STAY HERE WITH YOU!
: I WANT TO STAY! I WANT TO STAY!
scene resetwithmaya5
: I’d appreciate if you’d forget everything I just said.
: Yeah, I don’t think that’s going to happen.
: How long has it been?
: It’s started, right?
: Yeah...
: It hasn’t been very long, I don’t think. But it felt weird being on the rooftop without you, so...
scene resetwithmaya6
: Hah...
: You really are hopeless without me after all...
scene black
Maya releases her grip on my shirt and the markings left by her tears quickly turn from hot to cold in what seems like a direct mirror of her mood tonight.
She wipes the ones not caught by my clothing off with her hands before bringing them to her own shirt and causing us to match in one more subtle way.
The good thing is that only one set of empty eyes remains now.
The bad thing is that they belong to me-
And that even now, I can’t help but put myself first.
scene resetwithmaya7
: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
: If this is about my little outburst just now, I’d like to make it known that I was extremely disoriented after waking up from a nightmare and-
: I thought you were gone...
: I came in here twice...and I couldn’t see you either time...I don’t understand...
: If it wasn’t for Sensei, I never would have-
scene resetwithmaya8
: Ayane, if it wasn’t for you, I’d probably still be moping around on the roof right now. You’re the one who helped me get off of my ass and actually do something.
: Yes, but-
: Don’t beat yourself up about the weird mechanics surrounding the end of the world. Especially now that we know Maya doesn’t really understand them either.
scene resetwithmaya9
: Excuse me- I never claimed to be an expert at this. But, just for curiosity’s sake, exactly what are you referring to right now?
: The fact that Ayane’s back again and not pregnant.
: Yeah, I still don’t believe that.
scene resetwithmaya10
: Why don’t you ever believe me when I tell you I’m not pregnant?! I know my body better than you do, Maya!
: What’s more concerning than that is how you managed to wake me up.
: What do you mean?
: I mean that I have tried that with you many times in the past and, without beating around the bush, it has always ended up rather catastrophically.
: Catastrophically how?
scene resetwithmaya11
: It...would probably be best to leave the details out for now.
: Well, I don’t like that at all.
: The fact that Ayane wasn’t able to see me is...curious, though. And calls into question a number of different things I’ve never really thought about before.
: It’s a shame she’s going to forget all of this yet again once we make it back to the roof.
scene resetwithmaya12
: You think I’m going to...forget again?
: Why wouldn’t I? That has happened 100%% of the times you’ve shown up during a reset. I have no reason to believe it won’t happen again.
: That was just one time, though...right? Nobody knows if that’ll happen-
: Nobody knows, that is correct. But I wouldn’t get my hopes up if I were you.
: Plus, I’m kind of rooting for your memory to get wiped right now so I don’t have to live with the embarrassment of all the things I just said.
: It’s bad enough that he heard them. And, if it weren’t for the dream I just had, I’d call the idea of you hearing those things as well my worst nightmare.
: You should be a little nicer to her, Maya. Ayane was willing to sacrifice her life to go out and look for you, you know.
scene resetwithmaya13
: I’m both flattered and thankful...truly. But what the two of you did was not only a complete shot in the dark, but an extremely foolish one at that.
: What would you have done if you attempted to wake me up and something horrible happened to me? How would you live with yourselves knowing that you were the cause?
: Probably the same way we’d live knowing we left this place...or...time without you.
: Plus, even if anyone can do it, resetting the world isn't my job. It's yours.
scene resetwithmaya14
: Sure. Leave the praying to one person who hates the gods more than you do. Fantastic idea.
: So...what happens now? Should we...maybe check the other dorm rooms?
: If Sensei was able to see you, maybe he can-
scene resetwithmaya15
: Unlikely. And it’s not something we should risk regardless.

: Judging the flow of time here is nigh impossible as it seems to come to a standstill. But given the fact that this is the first time in history that I’ve been the last one to wake up, I don’t want to take any chances.
: We need to get this over with as quickly as possible. And, should you still be there when we return, then we can talk about what’s going to happen next.
scene resetwithmaya16
: After we decide on a name for the baby, that is.
: Ha ha ha. Very funny.
scene resetwithmaya17
: On a brighter note...thank you, Ayane.
: I greatly appreciate it and now feel quite horrible with myself for all of the times I watched you fade away into nothingness.
: I’m going to ignore that last part and just pretend you only said “Thank you,” okay?
scene black
What Maya said about the flow of time here must be accurate as everything seems to come to a standstill while we’re inside of the dorms.

In fact, I’m so caught up in my head about the prospect of how this will play out next time that I can’t even bring myself to focus on the girls as they change back into their casual clothes in front of me.
Maya shows restraint at first, but Ayane’s adamance about no one leaving each other’s sight again quickly coerces her into changing her stance and...
Well, paired with the fact that Maya has, once again, all but confessed her feelings to me, taking off her clothes must not seem like that big of a deal in the end.
scene clearnightsky
It’s funny, isn’t it? How quickly the idea of tragedy can cause one’s mind to spiral out of control. And how the overturning of said tragedy brings us right back to the starting line.
Somewhere, a wooden carving of a god is laughing itself to death inside of a glass box, knowing full well that it is the icon of all that is unjust in this world.

And that each and every one of us who pay admission prices to gaze into its empty eyes are attempting to translate and disfigure that laughter into a series of noises that provide us some form of comfort.
I ask you, what is there to be comfortable about here?
How can anyone find comfort knowing that, at any second, the things they need the most can be stripped away without warning?
There is no reason to laugh.
There is no reason to smile.

scene resetwithmaya18
: Wow...
: Was the moon always that big?...
: I...don’t think so...
: It’s almost like it’s...growing.
: We should hurry.
: Things have been changing rather rapidly in a multitude of ways as of late, and very few of those changes have actually been beneficial.
: The last thing we need is a giant moon crashing into us as we’re attempting to reset the world.
: The fact that I took that sentence seriously is a good indicator of how weird my life has suddenly become.
: Welcome to the club, Ayane. We meet once every four months or so.
: Oooooh, we should make special “end of the world” t-shirts for next time. If Maya’s theory is wrong and I’m still around, that is.
: Can you two please take this seriously?
: Hey, I don’t even know what I’m supposed to do yet. Sensei told me hours ago that you’d fill me in on all of the details, but then you weren’t here and we had that big heartfelt reunion and-
: Just stop talking and hug him.
scene resetwithmaya19
: Wow. If I knew it was that easy, I would have started hours ago.
scene resetwithmaya20
: If you’d started hours ago, you’d likely be conversing with a version of me significantly more chipper than the one you’re seeing right now. Now close your eyes.
scene resetwithmaya21
: Maya, you don’t have to hide your excitement about hugging Sensei from me. If there is anyone who understands that feeling, it is Ayane Amamiya.
: I am excited to open my eyes and have you gone. That is what I’m excited for.
: Aww, but I think we make a cute little family. I’m the mom, Sensei is the dad, and you’re the gardener he’s having an affair with.
: Ha. So you are pregnant after all.
: Am not.
: Are too.
: Am not.
: Are- wait, why am I even going along with this when I’m supposed to be praying?
: You know, out of all of these that I’ve been through so far, this one is definitely the weirdest.
: I really wish I could say the same.
: And I really wish that-

: Is it over? Can I open my eyes?
scene resetwithmaya23
: You’re...still here?
: I think so. Unless I’m not actually the real Ayane and was just replaced with a fake one who looks exactly the same and loves Sensei just as much.
: Probably even more, now that we’ve been through an apocalypse together.
: We’re back, right?
scene resetwithmaya24
: Uhh...yeah. I think so.
: Do we always respawn in Sensei’s office? This seems like a weird starting point.
: I mean...it’s not entirely unheard of. But it’s also not like it’s the...usual process or...

: I have no idea. This is an entirely new experience for me.
: That said, I think it would be best for the three of us to-
: Senpai! Are you in- woah! Okay! I didn’t see anything! Don’t kill me!
scene resetwithmaya25
: Hah...or we can wait until later to talk about this. That’s fine too.
: Is there something you need, Imani?
: Yeah. I need you to do your friggin’ job instead of mackin’ it with your students all morning.
: Just how many sexual encounters am I gonna walk into in here?
: Um...hopefully zero.
scene resetwithmaya26
: And why aren’t you two in uniform? It’s one thing to show up late, but to show up late and improperly dressed, AND about to have a threesome in the office?
: Listen, I’m trying to be the cool student teacher and all, but I’ve gotta put my foot down somewhere. At least fix one of those things, yo.
scene resetwithmaya27
: So...threesomes are okay as long as I'm wearing my uniform?
: What is it with you and threesomes, man? What kind of insatiable beast requires a minimum of two girls for every sex act?
: I am too exhausted from everything I just went through, so-
: Yeah, I bet you are.
: ...So I’m going to just agree to whatever papers you need me to sign so you can be on your way.
scene resetwithmaya28
: Papers? What? No. Class started an hour ago and you’ve been in here going to town on these two  the whole time.
: Imani, they’re fully clothed. Does it really look like we just finished having a threesome?
: Well, sorry Senpai, but I’m struggling to think of another scenario that would lead to a full-on group hug like that.
: That’s just one of the steps to resetting the world.
scene resetwithmaya29
: Got it. That makes a lot more sense.
: We’re sorry. We just...really had to talk to Sensei about-
: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I don’t need your excuses. Just go wait in the hall while I deal with this guy and then we’ll all walk back to class together.
: Come on, Ayane. We can postpone our full discussion until later.
: Oh...Okay. Yeah.
: I guess we’ll just...go wait out there and...leave Imani and Sensei to talk about threesomes together.
: I highly doubt that will be the conversation topic we land on, Ayane.
scene resetwithmaya30
: Good...
scene resetwithmaya31
: What?
: Nothing. I’m just waiting for you to deal with me.
scene resetwithmaya32

: You’ve gotta come to class, man. If you keep slacking off like this, they’re gonna give all your students to me and then you won’t be able to afford taking all fifty of your girlfriends out on dates anymore.
: My bad. Something just...came up this morning.
: Yeah...now that I’m closer, I can kinda see that. You look really tired, Senpai. Everything okay?
: You’re not worried about today, are you? Cause I already told you I’d handle the announcement and everything. I just...you know, need you in the room so Makoto doesn’t think I’m overstepping again.

scene resetwithmaya33
: The club announcement, Senpai! The Great Migration!
: The...what?
: The deadline for the new school policy kicks in tomorrow! A bunch of clubs got replaced with new ones and everybody needs to sign up for one in the next 24 hours!
: Or what?
: Or-
scene resetwithmaya34
: Wait, yeah. Or what?
: They wouldn’t actually expel people over that, would they?
scene resetwithmaya33
: Either way! We’ve got a job to do! And we can’t do that job from our office!
: My office.
scene resetwithmaya35
: But I don’t have an office and I want you to share with me...
: Borrow Wakana’s office. You two are friends now, right?
: She put a sign on her door saying “No Imani” which, not gonna lie, is a pretty bad look for her since I’m the only black girl around here.
: Yeah...I think she might want to take that down before there’s a misunderstanding.
: You’ll never try to keep me out of your office...right, Senpai?
: Just please knock from now on. It’s not really good for me if you think I’m having threesomes all the time.
scene resetwithmaya32
: I don’t know, man. I think that makes you seem pretty damn cool. But hey, if you’d rather me look at you as some kind of pansy ass cherry boy, I can do that too.
: Okay, on that note, we should probably get to class now.
: Oh, yeah. That’s the note that gets you to class. Not the morning bell or the weight of future generations that should be pressing down upon your shoulders at all times.
: After you, my king.
scene black
Well...it looks like I’m being thrown right back into the thick of things without being given a chance to process all that’s happened over the last...however long we were at the end of the world for.
I’m not sure what to make of the fact that Ayane has managed to retain her memories of the reset, but...that can’t possibly be a bad thing, can it?
Sure, it might be putting an aeon’s worth of unnecessary strain on her already over-exhausted mind, but...
Maybe it could bring us closer together?
The opposite goes for Maya, though.
How will she handle the idea of someone else joining us up there?
How will she view the one thing the two of us can freely share now that it’s being infiltrated?
I ask myself a variety of questions just like this on the way back to the classroom.
But the one that I have trouble answering-
Is if she’ll wake up next time.
